coordinate_system: Y-up, -Z forward; one exported unit is one meter

asset_contract.title: Maritime Aether Equipment
asset_contract.summary: Two 10-energy-unit wind crystals, a 20-energy-unit aether receiver, a catching staff, and a three-slot wooden deck rack with iron rails. Legacy petrol asset IDs are retained for reference compatibility. Geometry and sockets are supplied; gameplay logic and physics belong in the game.
asset_contract.placement: Each file has one root at its floor contact/butt end, recentered to zero. Source units are meters. Staff length is approximately 2.08 m; crystal vessels are approximately 0.87 m tall above their roots.

nodes.name: JerryCan_Red / JerryCan_Teal
nodes.role: Independent crystal roots. Each has _Cap (focus seal), _Grip, _Catch, and _Pour (energy focus) children prefixed with its legacy root name. capacity_energy is 10 units.

nodes.name: FuelMotor_Refill
nodes.role: Energy-channel target at the open receiver; local +Z points out of its inlet in Blender.

nodes.name: FuelMotor_CapHinge
nodes.role: Open pose is authored zero; rotate local X +90 degrees to close. Parent of FuelMotor_Cap.

nodes.name: CanCatcher_MainGrip / CanCatcher_SupportGrip
nodes.role: Hand placement points at 0.20 m and 0.70 m along the shaft.

nodes.name: JerryCanRack / JerryCanRack_Slot_01 / JerryCanRack_Slot_02 / JerryCanRack_Slot_03
nodes.role: Static rack root at deck level and three can-root placement sockets, spaced 0.44 m apart. Each socket includes its floor-contact offset.

asset_contract.contents: Meshes, translucent materials, and four-second wind transform clips; no character rig, collision meshes, or gameplay scripts. Frames 1 and 97 match, with playback on 1–96 at 24 fps. The rack exports empty. Receiver capacity_energy is 20 and initial_energy is 0; the active showcase effect demonstrates its powered appearance. FBX transparency and emission may require engine material setup.
asset_contract.movable_parts: Crystal caps are separate focus seals; leave them attached during energy transfer. Wind_1 and Wind_2 meshes rotate around local source Z, carrying their motes. FuelMotor_Cap is parented to FuelMotor_CapHinge; local X zero is open and +90 degrees is closed.

setup_steps: Import each file as a separate prefab, preserving named sockets and mesh hierarchy. Loop the supplied four-second wind clip. No character rig is required. Configure alpha-blended crystal materials and emissive wind for your render pipeline.
For a two-handed pose, attach the player hand to CanCatcher_MainGrip using its inverse local transform.

Place JerryCanRack at deck level. Its footprint including anchor ears is 1.42 by 0.634 m and its height is 0.30 m. The rack exports empty; add either can variant to any Slot_01/02/03 transform with unit local scale and identity local rotation. Keep one can per slot, disable its free physics while stored, and restore physics when lifted out. Slot occupancy and storage logic are not supplied.
Use one rigidbody per can. Add a small catch trigger near its handle; use swept collision/continuous collision detection for fast falling cans.
When a falling can enters the hook trigger, align its _Catch socket to CanCatcher_Catch, disable its free-fall physics and attach it. Hold at most one can; detach and restore physics on release.
For energy transfer, keep the crystal focus seal attached and the receiver cap open. Aim the legacy _Pour focus at FuelMotor_Refill; no liquid or pouring pose is needed.

Transfer energy only while actively channelling, in range, and the receiver is open: amount = min(rate * dt, crystalEnergy, receiverCapacity - receiverEnergy). Subtract and add the same amount. Clamp both stores and prevent duplicate transfer calls.
Receiver initial_energy is zero. Hide its Heart_Wind meshes and child motes while empty; enable them when energy is available. The showcase intentionally displays the powered appearance.
Socket positions survive coordinate conversion; source +Z normally maps to engine +Y. Inspect local axes before applying cap rotations or a first-person hand pose.
optional_recipes.collision: Use boxes for can shells and motor body, capsules for pole shaft and hook segments, and separate small triggers for catch/refill. For the static rack use separate boxes for the floor, rails, and dividers, plus one optional trigger per bay; leave all three openings clear. Avoid one convex hull over the hook or rack openings. Do not give decorative ribs, bolts, or labels colliders.

examples.title: Bounded energy transfer
examples.code:
if channelling and receiver_open and focus_in_range:
    amount = max(0, min(rate * dt, crystal.energy, receiver.capacity_energy - receiver.energy))
    crystal.energy -= amount
    receiver.energy += amount
